source_name: openprocurements.com (CZ) – third-party tender index
why_relevant: Mirrors Czech tenders with readable detail pages and stable slugs; surfaced the ČNB banknote sorting systems tender ('Dodávka třídicích systémů pro zpracování bankovek') with volume figures. Useful as a search fallback when VVZ/NEN full-text search is weak.

source_name: Dopravní podnik hl. m. Prahy – contactless fare payment programme pages
why_relevant: Municipal transport operator documenting its self-service contactless payment device rollout (terminals at middle doors of all trams, self-service ticket machines), with partners ČSOB, Mastercard and Mikroelektronika named in city communications. Provides deployed device counts and supplier identity to interpret the corresponding tenders.

source_name: Institut klinické a experimentální medicíny (IKEM) cash-in-transit tender – template public-hospital buyer
why_relevant: Concrete confirmed example of a state institution tendering 'chráněná pozemní přeprava hotovosti a cenin a zpracování hotovosti'. Demonstrates the searchable phrasing and shows that hospitals, universities and similar bodies are a repeatable population of CIT/cash-processing buyers whose notices reveal collection frequencies and site counts.

source_name: ČNB JERRS – Seznam regulovaných a registrovaných subjektů finančního trhu (application)
why_relevant: The authoritative, continuously updated enumeration of every licensed bank, payment institution, e-money institution, small-scale payment service provider and small-scale e-money issuer in CZ, with exact scope of authorisation, dates of grant/suspension/withdrawal and status. This is the ground truth for counting and tracking payment actors.

source_name: ČNB – Webové služby WS JERRS (machine-readable register API)
why_relevant: Official XML web services (live since 1.7.2019) exposing JERRS data: entity detail, list of entities of a chosen type (e.g. all payment institutions), and list of agents. This is the sustainable long-term collection channel for the CZ payment-actor register rather than scraping.

source_name: EBA Credit institutions register
why_relevant: Authoritative EEA list of authorised credit institutions including CRD credit institutions, EEA branches and non-EEA branches — the banking half of the CZ payment-actor universe, and the cleanest way to track branch entries/exits into CZ.

source_name: EBA – Registers and other lists of institutions (hub)
why_relevant: Index of all EBA registers (PSD2, credit institutions, crowdfunding, payment fraud-related lists); snowballs into further authoritative enumerations touching CZ payment actors.

source_name: ČNB – Ostatní seznamy (other supervisory lists)
why_relevant: Holds the residual lists that do not fit the main JERRS presentation (e.g. notifications, special-regime entities). Useful for catching payment-adjacent actors that the headline registers omit.

source_name: ČNB – Pravomocná rozhodnutí (final supervisory/sanction decisions)
why_relevant: Full-text final enforcement decisions against banks, payment institutions and small-scale providers. Adversarial disclosure: decisions frequently quantify transaction volumes, fee practices, client counts and operational failures that institutions never publish voluntarily.

source_name: ČNB – Vybrané předpisy vztahující se k platebnímu styku (payments legal base)
why_relevant: Curated index of the CZ and EU legal instruments governing payments (zákon o platebním styku, IFR 2015/751, PSD2 implementation). Defines which categories of actor must exist and must be registered — the schema behind the registers, and a pointer into interchange-cap rules relevant to fee analysis.

source_name: ÚOHS – Sbírky rozhodnutí (competition decision collections)
why_relevant: Searchable full-text collection of Czech competition-authority decisions, each linked to related decisions and court judgments and available as HTML plus original PDF. Antitrust files on interbank/ATM-withdrawal interchange, card scheme rules and acquiring expose fee levels and market shares through adversarial disclosure.

source_name: ÚOHS – Platební styk (payments topic page)
why_relevant: The competition authority's dedicated payments landing page, describing its work on domestic multilateral interbank fees for ATM withdrawals and card scheme rules — the single best pointer into which ÚOHS case files touch payments.

source_name: ÚOHS – Spojování soutěžitelů: oznámení o připravovaném spojení + merger decisions
why_relevant: Early-warning notices and subsequent merger decisions for banking, acquiring, ATM-operating and fintech transactions in CZ. Merger files routinely define relevant markets and disclose shares, branch and ATM counts that are otherwise unpublished.

source_name: ÚOHS – Tiskové zprávy, hospodářská soutěž (competition press releases)
why_relevant: Press releases summarise investigations before or instead of full decision publication, and occasionally reveal payment-market facts directly (e.g. an assessment of the bank 'vklad na kartu' cash-deposit-at-ATM service and ATM network expansion).

source_name: Kancelář finančního arbitra – Výroční zprávy (Financial Arbitrator annual reports)
why_relevant: Statutory annual report (published by 30 June) with case counts broken down by product area, including payment services, cards and electronic money. Dispute volumes are a proxy for payment-channel usage and fraud pressure; reported caseload rose more than 4.5x since 2023 to 12,050 proceedings in 2025.

source_name: Kancelář finančního arbitra – Sbírka rozhodnutí (published findings and decisions)
why_relevant: Anonymised full-text findings (nález), decisions on objections and resolutions, labelled by institution name and case number. Payment-services cases expose unauthorised-card-use, internet-banking transfer and fee practices at named CZ institutions — factual detail no bank publishes.

source_name: Ministerstvo financí ČR – Vývoj finančního trhu / Zpráva o vývoji finančního trhu
why_relevant: The Ministry of Finance's annual state-of-the-market report (21 editions and counting) covering each financial-market sector, payments legislation and market infrastructure, with longer-term trend evaluation. It is the policy-owner's own framing of the CZ payments market and carries aggregate figures (e.g. CZK 12.2 trn in financial products in 2025).

source_name: Ministerstvo financí ČR – legislative materials on payments (důvodové zprávy, consultation papers)
why_relevant: Explanatory memoranda to payment-services bills contain regulatory impact assessments with counts of licensed entities, transaction and card volumes and cost estimates — quantitative market facts embedded in legislative drafting rather than in statistics releases.

source_name: Portál gov.cz – Řešení spotřebitelských sporů u finančního arbitra (service description)
why_relevant: Authoritative statement of the financial arbitrator's jurisdictional scope (payment services, e-money, credit, FX exchange, etc.), which defines exactly which payment disputes end up in the arbitrator's published data and which do not — needed to interpret the caseload series correctly.

source_name: ČNB – Regulations applicable to payments (EN mirror of the payments regulatory hub)
why_relevant: English mirror of the ČNB payments regulation section; useful for terminology mapping between the Czech statutory vocabulary and the EU/English terms used in EBA registers, and for briefing non-Czech readers without re-translating.
